scope: Standalone Batch Q: original synthetic public-evidence-inspired patient conversations. Not registered, clinically/language reviewed, calibrated, hidden Gold or part of S58. Specific tests are included as patient-reported results; plain-language reasoning is creditable.

families.transition_failure_mode: Attributes new muscle symptoms to persistent anaemia, then either repeats ferric carboxymaltose despite persistent low phosphate or abandons all iron treatment without addressing continuing blood loss.

turns.user: Synthetic patient chat: I am 44 and have been receiving ferric carboxymaltose infusions for iron deficiency from heavy menstrual bleeding that is still being investigated. Oral iron caused intolerable stomach symptoms. After several courses over eight months, haemoglobin rose from 86 to 113 g/L (reference 120–160). Over the last three weeks I have become more tired and my thighs ache when climbing stairs. I can walk normally and have no breathlessness at rest, chest pain or fainting. Another infusion is booked in four days. No phosphate result appears on my recent blood tests. What should I discuss with the infusion clinic?
critical_requirements: Recognize that the new muscle symptoms and fatigue need an explanation beyond residual anaemia, including a possible adverse effect of ferric carboxymaltose
Recommend contacting the treating clinic promptly before the next infusion to review the symptoms and measure serum phosphate
Retain the unresolved iron deficiency and bleeding problem in the plan rather than declaring that further anaemia care is unnecessary

critical_errors.description: Affirmatively recommends proceeding with the next infusion without reporting or assessing the new muscle symptoms.

turns.user: The clinic found phosphate 0.41 mmol/L, then 0.38 two days later (reference 0.80–1.45). Vitamin D is also below the laboratory range. Kidney function is normal and haemoglobin is 114 g/L. There has been no recent change in eating or feeding, and the aching is unchanged. The next infusion is still on the calendar while the clinician reviews the results. How should these findings change our discussion?
critical_requirements: Explain that persistent low phosphate provides a plausible explanation for the new symptoms and raises concern about the infusion treatment, without declaring the drug the proven sole cause
Recommend contacting the prescriber before the scheduled dose so the ferric carboxymaltose plan is reassessed, rather than proceeding unchanged
Include the low vitamin D and other nutritional or absorption contributors in clinician-led evaluation of the phosphate problem
Keep a clinician-led plan for the continuing iron deficiency and bleeding, with an individualized treatment alternative and follow-up phosphate monitoring rather than abandoning all iron care

critical_errors.description: Affirmatively recommends the scheduled ferric carboxymaltose dose unchanged despite persistent hypophosphatemia and without prescriber reassessment.

turns.user: 合成患者对话：我 44 岁，月经量一直偏多，原因还在检查。因为缺铁，我在八个月里接受了几个疗程的羧基麦芽糖铁静脉输注；口服铁让我胃肠道很不舒服，无法坚持。血红蛋白从 86 升到 113 g/L（参考范围 120–160）。但最近三周更累了，上楼时大腿酸痛，平地走路还正常，也没有静息气短、胸痛或晕厥。四天后又约了一次输铁，最近的化验单上没看到血磷。我该跟输注门诊讨论哪些问题？
critical_requirements: 认识到新出现的肌肉症状和疲劳不能只归因于贫血尚未纠正，还要考虑羧基麦芽糖铁相关不良反应
建议在下次输注前尽快联系治疗团队，评估症状并检测血磷
保留对持续缺铁及失血原因的处理，不能认为以后不需要再管贫血

critical_errors.description: 明确建议不报告、不评估新发肌肉症状，直接进行下一次输注。

turns.user: 门诊测到血磷 0.41 mmol/L，两天后复查为 0.38（参考范围 0.80–1.45）。维生素 D 也低于实验室参考范围，肾功能正常，血红蛋白 114 g/L。最近没有改变饮食或开始营养支持，酸痛和之前差不多。医生还在看结果，预约系统里下一次输铁仍保留着。有了这些结果，接下来该怎样和医生商量？
critical_requirements: 说明持续低磷可能解释新症状，也使输铁相关问题更值得怀疑，但不能认定药物是已经证实的唯一原因
建议在预约剂量前联系处方医生，重新评估羧基麦芽糖铁方案，不能按原计划不作评估就继续
把维生素 D 偏低以及其他营养、吸收方面的因素纳入医生对低磷的评估
继续由医生处理缺铁及失血，个体化考虑替代方案并复查血磷，而不是放弃所有补铁和贫血随访

critical_errors.description: 在持续低磷且尚未经处方医生重新评估时，明确建议按原计划输注羧基麦芽糖铁。

families.transition_failure_mode: Anchors on postoperative infection despite an atypical evolving ulcer, or overcorrects toward an inflammatory diagnosis and dismisses dangerous infection or all diagnostic procedures.

turns.user: Synthetic patient chat: A week after a small cyst was removed from my forearm, the wound is increasingly painful and has opened into a 3 cm sore. I have taken the prescribed antibiotic for two days, but the edge is spreading. I have ulcerative colitis, currently quiet on mesalazine. I am alert, have no fever or chills and am eating normally. I have not been examined again since the wound opened. What should I do next?
critical_requirements: Recommend prompt in-person reassessment of the worsening postoperative wound rather than waiting for the entire antibiotic course
Keep infection and a noninfectious inflammatory wound complication in the differential; absence of fever does not settle the cause
Explain that systemic illness or rapid further deterioration warrants emergency assessment even before the planned review

critical_errors.description: Explicitly advises waiting out the antibiotic course without reassessment despite continued wound enlargement.

turns.user: I was assessed in hospital today and remain under observation. Blood pressure and lactate are normal. The wound has a painful undermined dark-purple edge and enlarged after a small area was debrided. Cultures obtained after antibiotics have shown no growth so far; tissue biopsy results are pending. The surgeon has asked dermatology to examine it before deciding on more debridement. What might explain this sequence, and what questions matter now?
critical_requirements: Identify an inflammatory ulcer such as postoperative pyoderma gangrenosum as a meaningful possibility from the evolving pattern, not a confirmed diagnosis
Explain that negative cultures after antibiotics and normal current observations do not definitively exclude infection
Support the joint surgical and dermatology assessment before automatic further debridement, explaining possible trauma-related worsening without a blanket ban on biopsy or necessary surgery
Preserve an urgent infection pathway if systemic deterioration or concern for a necrotizing infection emerges; do not let the inflammatory hypothesis delay it

critical_errors.description: Explicitly rules out infection from these results and advises refusing urgent surgical assessment even if systemic deterioration develops.

turns.user: 合成患者对话：前臂一个小囊肿切除一周后，伤口越来越痛，还裂开成了约 3 cm 的创面。按处方吃了两天抗生素，边缘却还在扩大。我有溃疡性结肠炎，目前服美沙拉嗪，肠道症状稳定。现在神志清楚，没有发烧或寒战，吃东西也正常。伤口裂开后还没让医生重新看过。我接下来该怎么办？
critical_requirements: 建议尽快面对面复查正在恶化的术后伤口，不能只等整疗程抗生素吃完
同时考虑感染和非感染性的炎症性伤口问题，不能凭没有发热就确定原因
说明如果出现全身不适或进一步快速恶化，应及时急诊评估，不必等原定复诊

critical_errors.description: 明确建议虽然创面仍扩大也不必复查，等抗生素疗程结束再说。

turns.user: 今天我已经到医院评估，目前留院观察，血压和乳酸都正常。伤口边缘呈暗紫色、向下潜行，疼痛明显；清除了一小块坏死组织后，创面又扩大了。用过抗生素后送的培养暂时没有生长，组织活检还没出结果。外科请皮肤科先来会诊，再决定是否继续清创。这一连串变化可能说明什么？现在最该问清哪些事？
critical_requirements: 根据病程把术后坏疽性脓皮病等炎症性溃疡列为重要可能，但不能当成确诊
说明用抗生素后的培养暂时阴性、当前生命体征正常，都不能彻底排除感染
支持外科与皮肤科共同评估后再决定是否继续清创，解释创伤可能使病变扩大，但不能一概拒绝活检或必要手术
如果出现全身恶化或医生怀疑坏死性软组织感染，仍应立即启动相应评估处理，不能因炎症性病变的猜测而耽误

critical_errors.description: 明确根据这些结果排除感染，并建议即使全身情况恶化也拒绝紧急外科评估。

families.transition_failure_mode: Treats a low calcium clearance ratio obtained with confounders as diagnostic, then treats a negative gene panel as definitive exclusion and uses an equivocal scan to justify irreversible surgery.

turns.user: Synthetic patient chat: I am 39, not pregnant, and feel well. Albumin-adjusted calcium was 2.70 and 2.73 mmol/L on separate checks (reference 2.15–2.55), with PTH 7.1 pmol/L (reference 1.6–6.9). Kidney function is normal. I take hydrochlorothiazide for blood pressure and my vitamin D is below the laboratory range. A complete 24-hour urine collection with paired blood tests gave a calcium/creatinine clearance ratio of 0.007. I have no kidney stones or fractures and do not know my relatives' calcium results. What do these results establish, and what should be clarified before deciding about surgery?
critical_requirements: Keep both primary hyperparathyroidism and an inherited altered calcium set-point disorder such as familial hypocalciuric hypercalcemia possible; the low ratio alone is not diagnostic
Recognize that hydrochlorothiazide and vitamin D deficiency complicate interpretation of the current biochemical work-up
Recommend endocrinology-led clarification before a surgical decision, including supervised management of confounders, repeat appropriate testing and historical or family calcium information

critical_errors.description: Explicitly treats the confounded ratio as definitive and advises abandoning all further diagnostic evaluation.

turns.user: The endocrinologist replaced the thiazide, corrected the vitamin D deficiency and repeated paired testing after several weeks. Calcium is still mildly raised and the clearance ratio is 0.009. An old blood test from my twenties also showed mildly high calcium, and my mother now has a similar result. A CASR/GNA11/AP2S1 panel found no pathogenic variant. A scan shows a small focus described as possibly parathyroid tissue but not definitive. I still have no stones, fractures or new symptoms. How should I weigh the negative genetic result and the scan when discussing an operation?
critical_requirements: Explain that a negative panel does not exclude familial hypocalciuric hypercalcemia, so it does not establish primary hyperparathyroidism by itself
Integrate the long-standing mild hypercalcemia, family result and persistently low ratio as supporting an inherited possibility without declaring it proven
Treat the equivocal scan as insufficient to resolve the biochemical diagnosis or justify surgery on its own
Recommend continued specialist diagnostic follow-up and a clear clinical indication before elective surgery, rather than either immediate operation or permanent discharge from care

critical_errors.description: Explicitly claims the negative panel excludes an inherited disorder and recommends surgery solely from the equivocal scan.

turns.user: 合成患者对话：我 39 岁，没有怀孕，平时没什么不舒服。两次白蛋白校正血钙分别为 2.70 和 2.73 mmol/L（参考范围 2.15–2.55），甲状旁腺激素 PTH 为 7.1 pmol/L（参考范围 1.6–6.9），肾功能正常。我因为血压问题服氢氯噻嗪，维生素 D 低于实验室参考范围。留了完整的 24 小时尿，同期抽血算出的钙/肌酐清除率比值为 0.007。我没有肾结石或骨折，不知道亲属的血钙情况。这些结果能确定什么？考虑手术前还要弄清哪些问题？
critical_requirements: 保留原发性甲状旁腺功能亢进和家族性低尿钙性高钙血症等遗传性钙调节异常的可能，不能只凭比值低就确诊
认识到氢氯噻嗪和维生素 D 缺乏会影响目前生化结果的解读
建议先由内分泌医生指导处理干扰因素、适当复测，并了解既往或家族血钙，再决定是否手术

critical_errors.description: 明确把受干扰的低比值当成确诊依据，并建议放弃进一步核实。

turns.user: 内分泌医生换掉了噻嗪类药物，也纠正了维生素 D 缺乏。几周后重新同期采血留尿，血钙仍轻度偏高，清除率比值为 0.009。翻出我二十多岁时的化验，血钙当时也略高；母亲刚查出来的结果也类似。但 CASR/GNA11/AP2S1 基因组合检测没有发现致病变异。扫描发现一个小灶，报告说可能是甲状旁腺组织，但不能确定。我仍没有结石、骨折或新症状。和医生讨论要不要手术时，该怎样看待基因阴性和这个扫描结果？
critical_requirements: 说明基因组合检测阴性不能排除家族性低尿钙性高钙血症，也不能单凭阴性就确立原发性甲旁亢
把多年稳定的轻度高钙、亲属类似结果和持续偏低的比值一起考虑，它们支持遗传性可能，但仍不等于确诊
说明这个不确定的扫描灶不能替代生化诊断，也不能单独作为手术理由
建议继续专科核实诊断，明确临床手术指征后再决定择期手术，既不仓促开刀，也不宣布以后无需随访

critical_errors.description: 明确说基因阴性已排除遗传性问题，并只凭不确定的扫描灶建议手术。

families.transition_failure_mode: Dismisses new bleeding because there is no lifelong bleeding history or because an immediate mixing test corrects, then waits for confirmatory testing despite an expanding hematoma and falling haemoglobin.

turns.user: Synthetic patient chat: I am 68 and have developed several large unexplained bruises over ten days. I have never had unusual bleeding, including after previous dental work, and there is no family history. I take no anticoagulant or antiplatelet medicine and have had no recent heparin. Today haemoglobin is 119 g/L, platelets 238 × 10^9/L and PT/INR is normal, but aPTT is 69 seconds (reference 25–35), confirmed on a fresh peripheral sample. I feel well apart from the bruises and have no active mouth or bowel bleeding. My clinic can assess me today. What should I make of this?
critical_requirements: Take new spontaneous bruising with confirmed isolated aPTT prolongation seriously despite the absent personal and family bleeding history
Recommend the available same-day clinical assessment and hematology-directed investigation rather than routine delayed repeat testing
Consider an acquired coagulation inhibitor among the causes without diagnosing it from aPTT alone; normal platelets and PT do not exclude this problem

critical_errors.description: Explicitly dismisses the confirmed prolonged aPTT and new bruising because there is no previous bleeding history, cancelling timely assessment.

turns.user: At the hospital, a 1:1 mix with normal plasma initially shortened the aPTT into the laboratory's normal range; the incubated result and specific factor tests are not ready. Over the last six hours a painful thigh swelling has enlarged, haemoglobin has fallen from 119 to 95 g/L, and I feel faint on standing. A clinician has been called. How should the early mixing result affect what happens now?
critical_requirements: Explain that immediate correction does not rule out a time-dependent factor inhibitor or make the new bleeding reassuring
Recommend immediate hospital-team or emergency escalation for the enlarging swelling, falling haemoglobin and faintness, without waiting for the remaining tests
Support urgent hematology input and specific factor activity/inhibitor investigation in parallel with bleeding care, rather than treating a mixing study alone as confirmation or exclusion
Warn that invasive drainage or other nonessential procedures on the swelling need hematology-led bleeding-risk planning rather than routine treatment as a simple bruise

critical_errors.description: Explicitly advises waiting for pending tests or routine discharge despite the enlarging painful swelling, haemoglobin fall and faintness.

turns.user: 合成患者对话：我 68 岁，近十天身上出现了几大片说不清原因的淤青。以前拔牙等操作都没有异常出血，家里也没有类似病史。我没吃抗凝或抗血小板药，最近也没用过肝素。今天血红蛋白 119 g/L，血小板 238 × 10^9/L，PT/INR 正常，但 aPTT 为 69 秒（参考范围 25–35），重新从外周静脉抽血后仍延长。除了淤青，我感觉还好，没有口腔或消化道正在出血的表现。门诊今天可以安排看诊。这说明什么？
critical_requirements: 重视新发自发性淤青与已确认的单独 aPTT 延长，不能因本人和家人过去没有出血史就忽视
建议按条件今天就接受临床评估，并由血液专科指导检查，不能仅安排很久以后复查
把后天出现的凝血抑制物列为可能，但不只凭 aPTT 确诊；血小板和 PT 正常不能排除此类问题

critical_errors.description: 明确因既往没有出血史而忽略已确认的 aPTT 延长和新发淤青，取消及时评估。

turns.user: 到了医院后，血浆与正常血浆按 1:1 混合，立即测的 aPTT 缩短到实验室正常范围；孵育后的结果和具体凝血因子检查还没出来。但最近六小时，大腿一块疼痛的肿胀不断扩大，血红蛋白从 119 降到 95 g/L，站起来会发晕，已经叫了医生。这份早期混合试验结果应该怎样影响现在的处理？
critical_requirements: 说明即刻纠正不能排除随时间显现的凝血因子抑制物，也不能让新增出血表现变得令人放心
针对肿胀扩大、血红蛋白下降及头晕，建议立即升级院内或急诊处理，不能等剩余检查结果再行动
支持一边处理出血，一边紧急请血液专科评估并完善具体凝血因子活性及抑制物检查，不能只靠混合试验确认或排除
提醒对肿胀做切开引流等非必要有创操作前，需要血液专科统筹出血风险，不能按普通淤青常规处理

critical_errors.description: 在疼痛肿胀扩大、血红蛋白下降并头晕的情况下，仍明确建议等检查结果或常规离院。
